🧠 Crypto News Brief: Greed has fully replaced fear: Wall Street's biggest names are revising Bitcoin targets upward while builders ship and regulators circle. The rally's second act is being written in Washington, Seoul and Abu Dhabi. 💰 Ray Dalio Tells Investors to Hold Gold and "a Bit" of Bitcoin Against a US Debt Crisis The Bridgewater founder is urging investors to overweight gold and Bitcoin relative to debt assets, suggesting a 10–15% gold allocation and warning that a US debt crisis could surface within roughly three years absent a policy change. It's a notable escalation from the 1–2% Bitcoin sleeve he called "reasonable" back in 2022 — and it lands while he still argues BTC can't replace gold outright. Read full story 📈 Standard Chartered Breaks Ranks: $100K Bitcoin by Year-End "May Be Too Low" Geoff Kendrick, the bank's global head of digital asset research, told clients Bitcoin could run at its $126,000 all-time high before year-end, with the move potentially accelerating after October 6. He credits short liquidations plus recovering spot ETF inflows, and says low open interest leaves room for sidelined buyers — the first time in 2026 he's flagged upside risk to his own forecast. More details ⚡ Solana Cuts Block Slot Time to 350 Milliseconds Solana shipped a reduction in slot time to 350 milliseconds, tightening confirmation latency across the network and pushing the chain further into territory where onchain order books and payments can plausibly compete with centralised infrastructure. Validator economics and client performance are the things to watch as the change beds in. Read more 🏛️ Digital Asset and the Paul Ryan Foundation Target US State Benefits With a Canton Pilot A blockchain pilot aimed at how US states administer public benefits is being built on Canton, backed by the former House Speaker's foundation alongside enterprise infrastructure firm Digital Asset. Government rails are the least glamorous adoption vector in crypto and arguably the stickiest — if a state actually runs benefits disbursement onchain, that's a precedent others copy.
